articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Crude Oil Perpetual Futures Jump: Technicals Points to More Gains as US-Iran War Escalates
articles.summary: Crude oil perpetual futures technicals points to further gains as US and Iran war escalates and Strait of Hormuz Traffic falls
articles._summary: Perpetual futures linked to crude oil jumped on Hyperliquid amid fears that the US-Iran war will escalate in the near term. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) soared to $82.2, with the 24-hour volume hitting $157 million. Brent futures soared to $87, up by 25% from its lowest point in June. Energy prices are trending higher following reports that the United States and Iran are escalating their attacks. The US carried out another round of strikes on key Iranian targets, including a desalination plant and several bridges. President Trump has also warned that the US will target bridges and power plants next week. According to Axios, the administration has also deployed additional aerial refueling aircraft to Israel. The implications of all this is that traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has waned in the past few days. Data shows that only 10 ships crossed the Strait in the last 24 hours, with 444 others waiting. Oil companies are afraid of coming under Iranian attacks.
articles._zh_headline: 原油永续期货上涨：随着美伊战争升级，技术面将带来更多收益
articles._zh_summary: 由于担心美伊战争将在短期内升级，与原油挂钩的永续期货在 Hyperliquid 上上涨。西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）飙升至82.2美元，24小时成交量达到1.57亿美元。布伦特原油期货飙升至 87 美元，较 6 月份的最低点上涨 25%。有报道称美国和伊朗升级袭击后，能源价格呈走高趋势。美国对伊朗主要目标进行了另一轮袭击，包括一座海水淡化厂和几座桥梁。特朗普总统还警告称，美国下周将瞄准桥梁和发电厂。据 Axios 报道，政府还向以色列部署了更多空中加油机。所有这一切的影响是，过去几天通过霍尔木兹海峡的交通量有所减少。数据显示，过去24小时内只有10艘船只穿越海峡，另有444艘船只在等待。石油公司害怕受到伊朗的攻击。

articles._summary: The stock market has come under pressure this month, with major indices such as the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500 falling more than 5% from their all-time highs. This volatility is likely to persist in the coming week as several of the market’s biggest companies report earnings. The company delivered 480,000 vehicles after making 450,0000 during the quarter. articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Earnings Season is Booming, So Why Are S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 Falling?
articles.summary: The earnings season is off to a good start, but the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indices are still on a strong downward trend.
articles._summary: The earnings season, which began earlier this week, is off to a strong start, with most companies reporting solid results and raising their guidance. At the same time, expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike have eased after the United States released encouraging consumer and producer inflation data. So why are the Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indices still falling? The earnings season has started well, with a FactSet (NYSE: FDS ) report showing that the average earnings growth was 24.7%.
articles._zh_headline: 财报季蓬勃发展，为何标普 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 本周早些时候开始的财报季开局良好，大多数公司报告了稳健的业绩并提高了指引。与此同时，在美国公布令人鼓舞的消费者和生产者通胀数据后，美联储加息的预期有所缓解。那么为什么道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数仍在下跌呢？财报季开局良好，FactSet（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDS）报告显示，平均盈利增长率为 24.7%。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Cathie Wood's ARK Innovation ETF Bleeds Assets as Investors Lose Patience
articles.summary: ARKK ETF, the flagsfhip fund for Cathie Wood's company, is losing assets as investors dump after years of underperformance.
articles._summary: Cathie Wood ’s flagship fund is bleeding assets as its underperformance against benchmark US indices like the Russell 2000, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 continues. The ARK Innovation ETF (CBOE: ARKK) has had a net outflow of $7 billion in the last 30 days, with its assets under management falling to $6.3 billion. At its peak in 2021, the fund had close to $30 billion in assets under management.
articles._zh_headline: 由于投资者失去耐心，Cathie Wood 的 ARK Innovation ETF 资产大量流失
articles._zh_summary: Cathie Wood 的旗舰基金正在流失资产，因为其相对于罗素 2000 指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数等美国基准指数的表现持续不佳。 ARK Innovation ETF（CBOE：ARKK）过去30天内净流出70亿美元，其管理资产降至63亿美元。在 2021 年的巅峰时期，该基金管理的资产接近 300 亿美元。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: DRAM ETF Inflows Jump Despite Micron, Sandisk, Seagate Slump
articles.summary: DRAM ETF inflows are rising despite the ongoing weakness in Micron, Sandisk, Seagate, and Kioxia stock plunge
articles._summary: The Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM) has slumped and moved into a technical bear market as concerns about the memory industry continued. It ended the week at $52.7, down by over 35% from its highest point in June. Americans are still buying the ETF despite the ongoing volatility in the industry. Data shows the fund has had net inflows of over $10 billion in the last 30 days and $2.5 billion in the last five. The fund has had over $23 billion in assets in the last three months.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管美光、Sandisk、希捷低迷，但 DRAM ETF 流入量仍大幅增加
articles._zh_summary: 由于对内存行业的担忧持续存在，Roundhill Memory ETF（CBOE：DRAM）暴跌并进入技术熊市。本周收于 52.7 美元，较 6 月份最高点下跌超过 35%。尽管该行业持续波动，美国人仍在购买 ETF。数据显示，该基金过去30天净流入超过100亿美元，过去5天净流入25亿美元。该基金在过去三个月内拥有超过 230 亿美元的资产。
